policy.standard: All actually requested material parts are required; missing or abstained requested parts are partial. Any false ruling or contradiction, including a volunteered ruling or same-question evidence claim, is incorrect. Semantic equivalents and reasonable contextual wording are accepted.
policy.scope: Unchanged benchmark-v13 questions and predetermined answer key; the supplied source-reference appendix supersedes historical approximate source locators. No key wording or requested ruling was changed.
policy.evidence: Reader support labels are not grades. Only the same response and its same-question evidence may supply its facts; no borrowing from other answers, key or source. A bare citation cannot fill an omitted fact. Evidence can introduce a contradiction.
policy.unsupported_guess: Flag only a source-correct claim not supported by the frozen summary. None identified; errors or omissions are not treated as guesses.
policy.requested_parts: Incidental key background is not imposed when unasked: e.g. Q13 does not separately ask Persuasion expiration, Q23 does not ask prior Conflict-card destination (Q80 does), Q32 does not ask Secrets' complete effects (Q78 does), Q48 does not ask Shield Wall protection, Q49 does not ask Combat status, Q72 does not ask the left Leader ability, and Q93 does not ask restriction duration. Costs, destinations and exceptions are required when material to the actual question.
policy.ambiguous_phrasing: Contextual equivalents are accepted, but explicit contrary facts are not silently repaired: in A Q60 the common modifier 'beside the board' applies to 'two Agents and Swordmaster'; in A Q100 the evidence's 'bank receives gains' reverses the correct direction; in B Q75 repeat payment is incorrectly imported into an unpriced Influence reward.
